version.changelog:
- Updated engine binary to version v0.5.0, with SHA-256 checksum preserved.
- SKILL.md significantly rewritten and simplified; now primarily in Chinese and focused on usage guidance and workflows.
- Clarified usage of optional external scanner (`--engine external/auto`) and details on input requirements.
- Instructions for enterprise integration improved: upload/reporting process and expected outputs are clearly described.
- Old metadata, feature lists, and detailed security guarantee sections removed for brevity.

llm.summary: The skill claims to be a local scanner and to include a Linux binary, but the package is missing that binary and the documented workflow can upload full scan results to arbitrary endpoints — the pieces are inconsistent and could leak sensitive data.

dimensions.detail: The name and description (a local skill scanner) align with the instructions. However SKILL.md and INSTALL.md claim an included binary at assets/bin/skillscan with a SHA-256, yet the manifest does not include that binary or its checksum file — an inconsistency between claimed capability and what is actually present.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell users to run the scanner on arbitrary local skill bundles and explicitly support an --upload-url option where the upload payload contains 'embedded review details' (not just paths). That creates a clear exfiltration channel for potentially sensitive contents of scanned packages. The docs also allow bridging to external scanners (--engine external/auto), broadening data flow to unknown third parties.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no bundled binary present for review. SKILL.md/INSTALL.md claim a prebuilt binary (with checksum) but it is not included in the provided files, so the actual executable behavior cannot be audited. If a consumer obtains and runs that binary, it could perform arbitrary I/O or network uploads; without the binary, you cannot validate its safety.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials, which is reasonable. But because the scanner supports uploading full review payloads to arbitrary URLs (and bridging to external engines), sensitive data could be transmitted without any declared credential prompts — the lack of declared env vars does not eliminate exfil risk.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags show always:false and no OS restriction; the skill does not request elevated or persistent platform privileges and does not claim to modify other skills or global agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Do not run or trust an absent/uninspected binary. Before installing or running this skill: 1) obtain the actual assets/bin/skillscan binary and its checksum from a trusted, documented source (homepage or signed release); 2) verify the binary's checksum and, if possible, inspect or run it in a sandbox; 3) avoid using --upload-url or external engine options with unknown endpoints (they will upload full review details); 4) request the upstream source/homepage and a reproducible build or source code so you can audit what the scanner will do. Because the package is incomplete and supports uploading full scan results, treat it as untrusted until you can verify the binary and its network behavior.
